status: Supplementary design fixed after initial price-rule and cost results, before computing withdrawal bounds
reason: Complete the comparison set with the economically available choice of withholding all modeled inventory; not an assumption that a price floor reveals cost.
source_fact: Swappa currently permits cancellation before purchase without penalty. Historical applicability to the 2023 panel is an additional maintained assumption; the live FAQ is not dated evidence of 2023 terms.
comparison: Withhold all modeled seller inventory on each test day, yielding zero incremental selling payoff. This changes the participation choice, beyond the frozen price-only comparisons.
economic_assumptions: Zero payoff is relative to retaining the device; cost denotes incremental opportunity cost of sale, not necessarily historical acquisition expenditure.
The modeled inventory payoff must represent the seller decision problem, or omitted inventory and outside-channel effects must be added.
The same specified cumulative foregone-profit budget covers withdrawal and all price-policy comparisons. Availability alone does not establish this behavioral bound.
This is a comparison on realized states, not a simulation of an alternative inventory path.
target: Observed-sale-weighted mean persistent listing opportunity cost, same target as original run
reporting: Preserve all original outputs. Report every specified case and distinguish sensitivity sets from confidence sets. No cost equality, dispersion cap, or selected regret tolerance.
